verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server that an agent can reach with a Better Auth session token (OAuth is listed as coming soon). It exposes programmatic email operations, including listing, searching, sending, drafting, deleting, bulk archiving and labeling, so mailbox automation can run without the UI. However, nothing documents a true headless mode, a CLI, or CI-pipeline usage; the self-hosting and 'developer-friendly' claims only hint at it. Missing for 10: documented headless/CLI runtime, CI integration guidance or examples, non-interactive auth suited to CI (OAuth still pending), independent hands-on corroboration.
